name: Lara Croft
source:
A highly intelligent and athletic British archaeologist who ventures into ancient tombs and hazardous ruins around the world.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lara_Croft]Wikipedia[/url]]

While she was exploring a jungle, she got captured by a secret group who kidnap girls to train them as sex slaves.
